$comment: The build config, separate from tsconfig.json so that the dev-only mock can be
`npm run typecheck` uses tsconfig.json, which covers src/ and mock/. `npm run
build` uses this file, which covers src/ alone. The consequence is that a mock
bug can never ship: dist/ has no dist/mock/ for a Dockerfile to copy, and there
is no code path from `npm start` to a scripted runner that accepts any password.
